activity.notes: Edison established his Menlo Park laboratory in 1876, developed the phonograph in 1877 and practical electric-light systems thereafter, and brought the Pearl Street central power system into operation in 1882. ATLAS uses this tightly documented invention-and-system-development phase.

sources.title: Thomas Edison Biography: 1847–1882 — National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service documents Edison's Menlo Park laboratory beginning in 1876 and the sequence of major inventions and electric-power development through 1882.
